title: Team offsite planning
body:
Offsite is set for the second week of March, probably in the Blue Mountains.
Budget is about four thousand dollars for twelve people, including food.
I need to book the venue by the end of this month or we lose the March dates.
Sam offered to sort out the minibus.
Still not sure whether partners are invited. Ask Priya what she thinks.
Agenda ideas: roadmap review, a hiring retro, and one afternoon with no laptops.
Remember the dietary list from last year, two vegetarians and one coeliac.
